description: B-1193 Retry path (Mike, 2026-11-15: the host decides what follows a networked co-op mission). A listen host and one client start co-op Defection as network_coop_mission_end_smoke does; after 40 s the host ends the mission as failed (--debug-end-mission 40:fail). Each machine shows only its own results; on a failed mission the host's default is Retry Mission, whose lobby start takes the client along from its results screen into Defection again. Asserts one results push per machine, the host's retry choice, a second Defection start and the mission live twice on both.

input_sequence.comment: Each process runs its own schedule (smoke_path); this one only bounds the test.
